body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN008551661 (PTHR13809)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Ggamma1 (FBgn0004921) and CG43324 (FBgn0263029)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source

PTHR13809 is [GUANINE NUCLEOTIDE-BINDING PROTEIN GAMMA SUBUNIT (PTHR13809)](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR13809)
and is annotated with 'G protein activity' based on (BOVIN|Ensembl=ENSBTAG00000003043|UniProtKB=P63212;)

Only the G-alpha subunit has G-protein/GTPase activity - the beta/gamma subunits do not.
title: PAINT issue: PTN008551661 (PTHR13809)
